control.change_summary: Add the separate ~/Repos student development workspace, platform-appropriate desktop access and development-folder visual metadata where safely supported, and CVD Visual Studio Code launcher repair to open ~/Repos while preserving all repositories and files beneath the workspace.

version_control_system.student_use: Download assignment materials, track file changes, and optionally publish portfolio artifacts.

source_hosting_client.student_use: Authenticate with the approved source-code hosting service and manage course repositories.

programming_language_runtime.student_use: Write, run, and debug Python programs using the course-approved language version.

test_runner.student_use: Run course-provided automated tests and review the results.

coverage_reporter.student_use: Run course-provided coverage checks and review which program statements were exercised.

source_code_ide.student_use: Create, edit, run, and debug course source files.

language_support.student_use: Provide Python language services, interpreter selection, testing, and debugging in the IDE.

code_quality_tool.student_use: Provide linting and formatting feedback for readable Python code.

diagram_support.student_use: Open and edit course diagrams inside the IDE.

pseudocode_support.student_use: Open and edit course pseudocode files with appropriate language support.

spell_checker.student_use: Identify likely spelling errors in documentation, comments, and source files.

file_viewer.student_use: Open common office and course-document formats inside the IDE.
